newsitem.title: USA: Telco Systems sees Q2 Feb 23 breaking even.
newsitem.headline: Telco Systems sees Q2 Feb 23 breaking even.

text.p: Telco Systems Inc said Thursday it foresaw its fiscal second quarter results coming "slightly above or below break even" due to shipping delays.

The company, which makes multimedia networking equipment for exchange carriers and other companies, said the delays were caused by the recent manufacturing consolidation from Fremont, Calif. to Norwood, Mass.

Telco, which plans to release its earnings on March 12, said orders for the second quarter are nevertheless expected to be higher than the preceding quarter as well as the second quarter of the previous year.
The company reported a share loss of $0.26 in the second quarter of 1996 against a profit of $0.12 a year earlier.
